model.title: Model configuration
model.help: Saved automatically for this connection. Changes apply to the next Agent task.

title: Channels
description: Chat with Terax through messaging apps.
defaults: Each connection has its own session in ~/.terax/workspace, using the Channel Agent, independently configured model options and full access. Conversation history is available in the AI sidebar.
localOnly: Connections are managed by the permanent Local window.
removeHint: Disable the connection before removing it. Conversation history is kept.
qrLabel: Scan this QR code with WeChat
emptyReply: The Agent finished without a text reply. View the conversation in Terax for details.
longReply: The reply continues in Terax. Open the Channel conversation to read the complete result.
runFailed: Terax could not complete this request. Check the Channel status in Terax and send a new message when it is ready.

loginState.waiting: Scan with your personal WeChat account and confirm on your phone. Only that account can send requests.
loginState.verify: Enter the verification code displayed in WeChat.
loginState.expired: The QR code expired. Start a new sign-in.

errors.unavailable: The Local window is unavailable. Open it and try again.
errors.network: WeChat is temporarily unreachable. The connection will retry.
errors.protocol: WeChat returned an unsupported response. Try signing in again.
errors.storage: Channel data could not be saved or loaded. Check the local data directory.
errors.configuration: Channel configuration is invalid. Check the records in ~/.terax/channels/config.json against the current configuration format.
errors.model: Choose an available model for this connection and configure its credentials in Settings.
errors.agent: The Agent run failed. Open the conversation for details.
errors.queue-full: The message queue is full. New requests are waiting for space.
errors.interrupted: Some messages were interrupted when the connection stopped. They were not run again automatically; please resend them.
errors.delivery: The reply could not be delivered. The result is available in the Channel conversation.
errors.account-mismatch: This connection belongs to a different WeChat account. Create another connection for a new account.
errors.duplicate-account: This WeChat account already has a connection.
errors.name: Use a name between 1 and 80 characters.
errors.route-save: The network route could not be saved. Other submitted settings have been kept. Please retry saving.

emptyDetail: Add a connection to authorize and configure it here.
removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? Existing chat history will be kept.
attachmentInstruction: Receiving an attachment alone does not mean the user wants it read or analyzed immediately. Decide whether to process it based on the preceding user request. If there is no clear task, briefly acknowledge receipt and wait for further instructions. Later messages may refer to previously received attachments.
